title: Prefix values determined by initial bits
statement: Let $f,g:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be Boolean sequences and let $i$ be a natural number. If $f(j)=g(j)$ for every $j<i$, then their weighted prefix values on positions below $i$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are Boolean sequences indexed by natural numbers
